import networkx as nx
edges = [(1,16), (5,15), (4,13), (2,7), (6,13), (8,9), (2,6), (8,15), (5,6), (7,15), (2,5), (3,12), (1,11), (9,14), (4,7), (12,16), (4,16), (1,9), (7,11), (6,11), (13,14), (3,16), (10,12), (12,13), (0,12), (1,3), (0,14)]
G = nx.Graph()
G.add_edges_from(edges)
try:
    cycles = nx.cycle_basis(G)
    min_cycle = min([len(c) for c in cycles]) if cycles else float('inf')
    print("Min cycle length:", min_cycle)
except Exception as e:
    print(e)
